<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text | check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rk-0001 | Profiling the live daemon perturbs the fleet. | Read-only tools only (sample, vmmap, ps); never attach a debugger that pauses it. |
| rk-0002 | Truncating a tap file loses unread signal bytes. | Truncate only below the consumed offset, under the tap mutex; test the offset math. |
| rk-0003 | A private daemon for bisecting touches the real tmux server. | Private -L tmux server and a temp state dir only (PrivateTmux). |
